evidence: Login with nonexistent_user_xyz@example.com showed toast "Invalid credentials. Try: emma@example.com", stayed on /login, header still showed Log in/Sign up buttons (no session created).

issue: Incorrect password is accepted, allowing sign-in without the correct password
actual: Logged in as emma@example.com using password "wrongpassword123" (never set by this account). App redirected to home page with toast "Welcome back!" and header showed authenticated user "Emma Green" with Sell button and profile menu, i.e. a signed-in session was created despite the wrong password.

issue: No missing-field feedback shown to seller
actual: Clicking "Create Listing" with all fields empty (no photo, title, description, price, category, condition, location) did not submit and did not navigate away, but produced no toast, inline error text, or any element with error/alert styling identifying which fields were missing - only the title textbox silently gained focus.

evidence: Submitting the create-listing form with price=-10 (all other required fields valid) did not navigate away and no listing was created (form remained on /create-listing with price field refocused). The price input is type=number, so attempting to set a non-numeric value ("abc") via the field results in an empty value, preventing non-numeric submission.

Created listing "Test Upcycled Chair" with 1 photo, description, price $89, category Furniture, condition Good, location Brooklyn NY, and upcycled=true. Detail page displays photo, "Upcycled" badge, category, condition, title, price $89, location, listed date, description, and seller Emma Green - all matching submitted data.

issue: No edit functionality exists for listings
actual: On My Listings, each owned listing only exposes View, Mark Sold, and Delete actions. The View button and "Manage Your Listings" link on the product detail page only navigate back to My Listings; no Edit button, form, or route was found anywhere to modify an existing listing's title, description, photos, price, category, condition, location, or upcycled status.

evidence: Clicking "Mark Sold" on an owned listing changed its status badge to "Sold" and toggled the button to "Mark Available" (toast: "Item marked as sold"); clicking it again restored "Active" status (toast: "Item marked as available"). Clicking "Delete" opened a confirmation dialog ("Delete listing? This action cannot be undone"); confirming removed the listing immediately from My Listings (toast: "Listing deleted").

After marking "Mid-Century Modern Armchair" sold, the Browse All Items count dropped from 10 to 9 and the listing no longer appeared in browse results. Its product detail page displayed "This item is no longer available" with no Add to Cart or Message Seller controls present (only "Manage Your Listings" for the owner), confirming it cannot be added to cart or used to start a purchase request.

Signed in as Emma Green: viewing her own listing (Mid-Century Modern Armchair) showed a "Manage Your Listings" button and no buyer actions. Viewing another seller's listing (Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf, seller James Wilson) showed only "Add to Cart" and "Message Seller" buttons with no Mark Sold/Delete/Manage controls.

Signed in as Emma Green (non-owner), clicked "Add to Cart" on Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf (seller James Wilson). Cart page shows "1 item" with the item's photo, title, location (Portland, OR), price ($320), and Total $320.00.

Clicking Add to Cart immediately produced toast "Added to cart!" and the header cart icon badge updated to "1" without navigation/reload. Opening the cart showed the line item, photo, location, price, and correct $320.00 total, all reflecting the addition without manual reload.

On Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf (owned by James Wilson, available), clicked "Message Seller", typed a non-empty message, clicked "Send Message". Toast "Message sent to seller!" appeared confirming submission.

issue: Sellers have no way to view purchase requests or buyer messages
actual: As buyer (Emma), sent a Message Seller note and a cart "Send Purchase Request" to Marcus Chen's "Vintage Denim Jacket" listing (both confirmed sent via toasts). Logged in as Marcus Chen (the seller) and checked all reachable views: header icons, profile dropdown (My Profile, My Listings, Log out), My Listings page, and each listing's actions (View/Mark Sold/Delete) - none show received purchase requests or buyer messages. The "My Profile" link itself returns a 404 "Page not found". No requested item or buyer message is viewable by the seller anywhere in the app.

issue: Unauthenticated direct access to protected routes shows a blank page instead of a sign-in prompt or redirect
actual: While signed out: clicking "Add to Cart" correctly redirected to /login with a toast. Clicking "Message Seller" opened a dialog with a disabled "Log in to message" button (acceptable clear prompt). However, directly visiting /create-listing or /cart while signed out rendered a completely blank page (no content, no redirect, no login prompt - document.body.innerText was empty), leaving the user with no indication that sign-in is required.

evidence: Registered new user "QA Tester One" with email qa.tester.one@example.com, password "password123" (>=6 chars), location "Austin, TX". Toast "Account created successfully!" appeared, app redirected to home page, and header now shows authenticated user "QA Tester One" with Sell button and profile avatar/menu, confirming automatic sign-in after registration.

Attempted to register a new account with email "QA.Tester.One@Example.COM" (case-variant of already-registered qa.tester.one@example.com) with a different name "Duplicate Tester" and different password. Submission was rejected: stayed on /register, toast "An account with this email already exists". Verified original account was not replaced: logged in with qa.tester.one@example.com / original password "password123" and header still shows original name "QA Tester One", confirming the duplicate attempt did not overwrite the existing account.

On duplicate-email registration attempt, feedback (toast "An account with this email already exists") appeared immediately without any navigation or page reload. The registration form remained fully visible and populated with the entered values (Duplicate Tester / QA.Tester.One@Example.COM / differentpass1 / Denver, CO), allowing the user to correct the email and resubmit without re-entering other fields.

Search "bookshelf" (title match) returned 1 item; typing "BOOKSHELF" (uppercase) returned the same 1 result, confirming case-insensitivity. Search "portland" (location-only term, matches no titles) correctly returned 3 items located in Portland, OR (Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf, Upcycled Pallet Coffee Table, Vintage Brass Floor Lamp), confirming search spans location field too. Clearing the search box restored the full "10 items available" unfiltered listing.

Typing into the search box updated both the "N items available" count and the results grid live (e.g., "bookshelf" -> 1 items, "portland" -> 3 items) immediately after each fill without clicking a submit/search button or reloading the page.

Applied category filter "Furniture" (3 items: Bookshelf $320, Coffee Table $175, Armchair $285, all Furniture) then added condition filter "New" (correctly narrowed to 2 items: Bookshelf and Coffee Table, both Furniture+New, excluding Armchair which is Like New). Then applied sort "Price: Low to High" while both filters remained active: results correctly reordered to Coffee Table ($175) then Bookshelf ($320), with the 2-item filtered set preserved (count stayed "2 items available"), confirming combined filters+sort produce correct results.

Each filter checkbox toggle (Furniture, then New) and sort selection (Price: Low to High) updated the item count and grid immediately without a submit action or reload. Clicking "Clear all filters" immediately restored the full unfiltered "10 items available" listing (sort selection persisted separately, correctly reordering all 10 items $35-$320 ascending).

issue: Category browsing from /categories does not apply the category filter to results
actual: On /categories, "Furniture" card correctly displayed "3 items". Clicking it navigated to /?category=furniture, but the Browse All Items section showed "10 items available" (all items, unfiltered) instead of the expected 3 Furniture items, and the Furniture checkbox in the sidebar Filters panel was NOT checked. The category selection from the Categories page has no effect on the displayed results/count.

issue: Availability status is not explicitly/consistently displayed on active listings
actual: Product detail page for an active listing (Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf) includes photo, "Upcycled" badge, category (Furniture), condition (New), title, price ($320), location (Portland, OR), listed date (Listed 2024-11-23), description, and seller (James Wilson) - all present. However, full page text (document.body.innerText) contains no explicit availability label (e.g., "Available"/"In Stock") anywhere; availability is only implied by the presence of the "Add to Cart"/"Message Seller" buttons. This is inconsistent with sold listings, which DO show an explicit "This item is no longer available" text (confirmed in FT-4 testing). Active listings should also explicitly state their availability status rather than leaving it implicit.
